local function StartTeleport(player)

	if destroyed then
		return
	end

	if not player
		or player == LocalPlayer then

		return
	end

	if teleportConnection then

		teleportConnection:Disconnect()

		teleportConnection = nil
	end

	selectedPlayer = player
	teleporting = true

	FistsReset_Enable()

	SelectedLabel.Text =
		"Player: " ..
		player.DisplayName

	SelectedLabel.TextColor3 =
		Color3.fromRGB(
			100,
			220,
			150
		)

	lastTeleport = 0

	task.spawn(function()

		task.wait(0.1)

		if not destroyed
			and teleporting
			and selectedPlayer == player then

			EquipFists()
		end
	end)

	teleportConnection =
		RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

			if destroyed then
				return
			end

			if not teleporting then
				return
			end

			if not selectedPlayer then

				StopTeleport()

				return
			end

			if not selectedPlayer.Parent then

				StopTeleport()

				return
			end

			if E.atmPaused and E.atmPaused() then return end
            if E.canFollow and not E.canFollow(selectedPlayer) then return end

			local character =
				LocalPlayer.Character

			local targetCharacter =
				selectedPlayer.Character

			if not character
				or not targetCharacter then

				return
			end

			local myHumanoid =
				character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
					"Humanoid"
				)

			local myRoot =
				character:FindFirstChild(
					"HumanoidRootPart"
				)

			local targetHumanoid =
				targetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass(
					"Humanoid"
				)

			local targetRoot =
				targetCharacter:FindFirstChild(
					"HumanoidRootPart"
				)

			if not myHumanoid
				or not myRoot
				or not targetHumanoid
				or not targetRoot then

				return
			end

			if myHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end

			if targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end

			local currentTime =
				tick()

			if currentTime - lastTeleport
				>= TP_INTERVAL then

				lastTeleport =
					currentTime

				myRoot.CFrame =
					targetRoot.CFrame
					* CFrame.new(
						0,
						0,
						-TP_DISTANCE
					)
			end
		end)
end

    function E.advanceGift(command,h,bounty)
        if E.options.mode=="manual" and state.giftConsumed==E.options.requestId then E.receivedOnce=state.giftConsumed end
        local wants=E.wantsGift()
        if state.phase=="give_prepare" or state.phase=="give" then
            local dead=h and ((type(h.health)=="number" and h.health<=0) or h.life~=state.life)
            -- A respawn can temporarily display zero before the real bounty arrives.
            local zeroConfirmed=false
            if bounty==0 and h and type(h.health)=="number" and h.health>0 and not dead
                and type(h.updated)=="number" and timeNow()-h.updated>=0 and timeNow()-h.updated<=1.5 then
                if state.zeroLife~=h.life or not state.zeroLast or timeNow()-state.zeroLast>1.5 then
                    state.zeroSince=timeNow(); state.zeroSamples=0; state.zeroSample=nil
                end
                state.zeroLife=h.life; state.zeroLast=timeNow()
                if state.zeroSample~=h.updated then
                    state.zeroSamples=(state.zeroSamples or 0)+1; state.zeroSample=h.updated
                end
                zeroConfirmed=timeNow()-(state.zeroSince or timeNow())>=5 and (state.zeroSamples or 0)>=6
            else
                state.zeroSince=nil; state.zeroLife=nil; state.zeroLast=nil; state.zeroSamples=0; state.zeroSample=nil
            end
            if zeroConfirmed then
                state.phase="respawn"
                state.giftConsumed=state.giftRequest
                E.receivedOnce=state.giftRequest
                return true
            end
            if not wants or state.recipient~=E.options.recipient or state.giftRequest~=E.options.requestId then
                state.phase=bounty and bounty>=THRESHOLD and "prepare" or "farm"
                -- Keep delivery exemption for this life: an already landed hit can settle later.
                E.status="Delivery canceled; returning to normal farming."
                return true
            end
            if not h or dead then
                state.phase="give_prepare"
                if h and type(h.health)=="number" and h.health>0 then state.life=h.life end
                E.status="Delivery still pending: waiting for the hunter to respawn."
                return true
            end
            if state.phase=="give_prepare" and E.deliveryReady(command,h) then state.phase="give" end
            return true
        end
        if wants and bounty and bounty>=THRESHOLD and state.phase~="respawn" then
            state.phase="give_prepare"; state.life=h.life
            state.recipient=E.options.recipient; state.giftRequest=E.options.requestId; state.giftExempt=true
            state.giftMode=E.options.mode
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

            audit.last=nil; audit.peak=bounty or 0; audit.loss=nil

        end

            audit.confirmed=0; audit.loss=nil; audit.bank=nil; audit.paid=false; audit.deaths={}; audit.credits={}
        end
        if m then audit.managerToken=m.token end
        if audit.bank==nil and validBank then audit.bank=m.bank end
        if validBank and audit.bank and m.bank>audit.bank then audit.paid=true end
        local previous=audit.last
        local fresh=h and type(h.updated)=="number" and now-h.updated>=0 and now-h.updated<=1.5
        local farming=state.phase=="farm" and not teamPaused and not audit.loss
        if farming then
            for id,peer in pairs(peers) do
                if id~=command.hunter then

                    local peerFresh=type(peer.updated)=="number" and now-peer.updated>=0 and now-peer.updated<=1.5
                    if old and peerFresh and old.token==peer.token and old.health and old.health>0 and now-old.updated<=3

                end

        else audit.victims={} end
        for _,queue in ipairs({audit.deaths,audit.credits}) do
            while #queue>0 and now-queue[1]>3 do table.remove(queue,1) end
        end
        while #audit.deaths>0 and #audit.credits>0 do
            table.remove(audit.deaths,1); table.remove(audit.credits,1); audit.confirmed+=1
        end
        if state.giftExempt then audit.exempt=true end
        if fresh and bounty then

                audit.loss={peak=audit.peak,exempt=audit.exempt,paid=audit.paid,bank=audit.bank,declines=0,started=now,hunterToken=h.token}
            end
            if audit.loss and previous and previous.bounty and bounty<previous.bounty then audit.loss.declines+=1 end
            audit.last={bounty=bounty,updated=h.updated}

            if not loss.killer and fresh and h.token==loss.hunterToken and type(killer)=="table"
                and killer.command==command.id and type(killer.at)=="number"
                and killer.at>=loss.started-15 and killer.at<=loss.started+5
                and type(killer.name)=="string" and #killer.name>0 and #killer.name<=160 then

            loss.paid=loss.paid or audit.paid or (validBank and loss.bank and m.bank>loss.bank) or false
            if fresh and bounty==0 and type(h.health)=="number" and h.health>0 then
